name: sealedrecord
description: Verify a sealed session record: recompute the SHA-256 chain, check Ed25519 entry signatures and time receipts, and match audio files to their anchors. One package, three readers: the library, a command line (npx sealedrecord verify), and a static web verifier. WebCrypto only, browser and Node.
